text:
mira: Morning — quick async check. I opened the docs PR for Node quickstart: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/412. CI is red because the sample-app mac wheel build is failing. PTAL if you have a minute?

jordan: on it. can you paste the failing log?

mira: paste below — main failure: `Error: Cannot find module 'sqlite3'` during `npm run build && npm run bundle` step. Seems optional native dep causing native wheel build to blow up.

sam: this is expected on mac runner sometimes. quick workaround is to skip optional deps in CI: `npm ci --no-optional`. I can update the sample-app Dockerfile and CI matrix unless we actually need sqlite for tests.

kevin: looked at the docs PR — small nits: the code snippet should show both `npx @redwood/sdk@latest init` and `npm install @redwood/sdk` example. Also add a note about `Client.create_stream` for the new Python SDK.

mira: thanks — will add both snippets. For Python SDK, should we keep the old snippet for a patch release branch? blocker is that `Client.stream` was removed so I updated calls but want to ensure it's backwards-compatible.

jordan: FYI I tried a local mac build and saw the same sqlite3 wheel compile error — `node-gyp` failing. If sam can drop `--optional` in CI that should unblock the docs deploy preview.

sam: pushing a quick branch now: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/commit/ab12cd. Changes: Dockerfile adds `ENV NPM_CONFIG_OPTIONAL=false` and CI step uses `npm ci --no-optional`. I'll open a PR in ~5m.

mira: awesome. once CI green we can merge docs PR and the sample-app PR. deploy preview bot, can you kick a preview after merges?

dev-docs-bot: deploy preview queued — https://deploy-previews.redwood.dev/preview/1599 :white_check_mark:

jordan: blocker for me: I need a test key with Dedicated sandbox to smoke test the mac artifact against the runtime. @sam can you create a throwaway key in LastPass and DM?

sam: created `devex-sample-2026` and DMed creds to jordan and mira. also updated OWNERS on the sample-app PR.

mira: plan for today: 1) address kevin's nits in docs and add dual code snippets; 2) merge sample-app PR after CI; 3) update python quickstart to `Client.create_stream` pattern and add migration note. Blockers: waiting for CI and the Dedicated key (thanks sam). ETA EOD PST.

kevin: I'll review the docs PR after lunch (1–2pm PT).

jordan: will smoke test sampleapp on mac once CI passes, ping here with results.

mira: thanks y'all — will post a follow-up when both PRs merged. :heart:
